subject: Re: HelioHealth vendor security questionnaire + request for SOC 2 / audit log docs
body:
From: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@heliohealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 1, 2025 at 12:12 PM ET
Subject: HelioHealth vendor security questionnaire + request for SOC 2 / audit log docs
Attachments: HelioHealth_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v2025-11.xlsx

Hi Hannah,

Thank you again for the demo last week.

As a next step for our security review, can you please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire and share the following artifacts:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (or at minimum the attestation letter + bridge letter if applicable)
2) Documentation on audit logging (what actions/events are captured, how customers access/export, and retention options)
3) A sample of audit log events (redacted/synthetic is fine)

We use a vendor intake portal for uploads here:
https://heliohealth.securityforms.com/vendor/intake/REDWOOD

Timing: if possible, we’d like to have the first pass by EOD Mon 12/8 so we can keep our internal steering committee on track.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Ramirez
GRC & Security Compliance Manager
HelioHealth


---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@heliohealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 1, 2025 at 9:46 AM PT
Subject: Re: HelioHealth vendor security questionnaire + request for SOC 2 / audit log docs

Hi Elena,

Understood — thanks for sending.

A few quick notes / questions so we can move fast:
- SOC 2 Type II: we can share the full report under NDA. If HelioHealth requires a mutual NDA in place first, we can do that via DocuSign today.
- Audit logs: we can share an overview doc and a synthetic sample event set (no customer data). Sean (cc’d) can also join a short call to walk through what’s captured + retention/export options.

Would it be helpful to do a 30-minute security review call this week to cover the “top 10” (SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, encryption, retention, sub-processors, incident response) and then we can complete the questionnaire with fewer back-and-forths?

A couple times that work on my side:
- Tue 12/2: 10:00–10:30a PT
- Wed 12/3: 9:00–9:30a PT
- Thu 12/4: 1:00–1:30p PT

Also confirming: all demo environment metrics/screenshots we’ve shown are synthetic (no customer traffic) — but for your review we’ll focus on the production controls (hosted + dedicated capacity options + private/VPC architecture).

Thanks,
Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference


---

From: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@heliohealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 1, 2025 at 1:18 PM ET
Subject: Re: HelioHealth vendor security questionnaire + request for SOC 2 / audit log docs

Hi Hannah,

A 30-minute security review would be great.

We do require an NDA before receiving the full SOC 2 report. If you can send a DocuSign, we can turn it around quickly.

For the call, can you please make sure we cover:
- HIPAA/BAA availability (we’re a covered entity; we’ll need clarity on whether you sign BAAs)
- Log retention (default retention, max retention, and whether we can bring our own storage/export to SIEM)
- Data residency (we’re US-based but have some constraints around where data is processed)

Wed 12/3 at 12:00–12:30p ET works (9:00–9:30a PT).

Thanks,
Elena


---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@heliohealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 1, 2025 at 10:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: HelioHealth vendor security questionnaire + request for SOC 2 / audit log docs

Elena — confirmed for Wed 12/3 12:00–12:30p ET.

On the items you flagged (high-level here; we can go deeper live):
- HIPAA / BAA: we can support a BAA for eligible enterprise engagements (we’ll align with your legal/procurement process). I’ll make sure we have the right stakeholders on our side to confirm specifics.
- Log retention + export: we have configurable retention controls and audit logs intended for compliance/auditability. We can discuss export patterns to your SIEM during the call.
- Data residency: we can pin processing to specific regions depending on deployment mode; private/VPC deployments are available for stricter requirements.

NDA: here’s a DocuSign link for mutual NDA (Redwood ↔ HelioHealth):
https://docusign.net/Signing/Redwood-HelioHealth-Mutual-NDA

In the meantime, here are two references that may help your team pre-read:
- Audit logs overview (internal-facing but fine to use as context during review): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SEC/Audit+Logs+Overview
- Demo security FAQ (short answers + pointers): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Demo+Security+FAQ

I’ll send a calendar invite separately once you confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Hannah

David

David / Elena,

NDA is fully executed on our side now — attaching the final PDF for your records as well.

As requested, I’m uploading the following to the HelioHealth portal today:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Attestation_Letter_2025.pdf
- Redwood_Audit_Logs_Overview.pdf
- Redwood_Audit_Log_Sample_Events.json (synthetic/redacted)

(Attached here as well in case email is easier for internal forwarding.)

For Wed’s security review call, here’s a proposed agenda so we stay tight to 30 minutes:
1) Deployment + data flow (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC)
2) Authentication + access controls (SSO/SAML, RBAC)
3) Audit logs (coverage, access, export, retention)
4) Encryption + key management (at rest/in transit; KMS options in private)
5) HIPAA / BAA process + next steps

Sean will join to cover logging/retention/export patterns and reliability-related questions.

See you Wed,
Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Email is best)
